description: Land Acquisition - Meenioluwa, Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains a declaration by the Minister for the acquisition of specific land parcels for public purpose, including detailed descriptions of the land lots, their extents, boundaries, and locations. While it mentions a government minister, the core content focuses entirely on land matters rather than government personnel changes or structural adjustments, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
